title: HD5161 3 in 1 Styling Hair Dryer
category: Home Appliances > Personal Grooming > Hair Dryers
key_features: 3 Detachable Attachments - Comes with Diffuser, Quill Style Comb, Aerofocus Nozzle to provide styling versatility. From defining your curls to straightening to everyday styling , the attachments provide flexibility for different hair types and styling needs.

3 Temperature Settings - The dryer comes with three adjustable temperature settings allowing you to customize the heat as per your styling needs. Whether you want a quick dry, smooth finish, or gentle styling, it adapts to your preference.
Cool Shot Button - The cool shot function releases a burst of cool air to set your hairstyle in place, giving you long-lasting results while adding shine and reducing frizz.
Perfect Gift for Women - With its sleek design, powerful performance, and user-friendly features, the Havells HD5161 makes for an ideal gift option for women who love styling their hair.
